column3: Kirino Route · There's No Way I Wouldn't Help My Little Sister
...She turned away from me without a word the moment I returned home.
Hey, Kirino. I have something to tell you.
...What? Didn't I say not to approach me any more?
Relax. I'm not going to do anything strange again.
Rather, no matter what kind of object you brought with you this time, I have absolutely zero trust in you now.
...I didn't bring anything with me today. There are a few people I want you to speak to.
Don't you have any learning ability? Are you a fool? I said I wouldn't ask Dad and Mom about it.
Nope, the ones I want you to talk with aren't our parents. You need not meet them directly either.
Then, who are they? And how am I going to speak to them?
...They are your friends. I'll have you speak with them in the chat room.
Although they always quarrel, Kirino truly thinks of those two as her important friends.
This could be a chance to get her memories back.
